clocks.sealedAtUtc: time the weekly snapshot payload was sealed and hashed
clocks.verifiedAtUtc: time the completed snapshot passes integrity and coverage checks
clocks.activatedAtUtc: time a verified snapshot becomes the active executable weekly truth
clocks.freezeTargetUtc: latest public information eligible for the weekly snapshot
clocks.effectiveFromUtc: earliest time execution may consume the snapshot
clocks.settlementDeadlineUtc: last time Limni may finish local acquisition and validation for live use
clocks.settlementCompletedAtUtc: time local acquisition and validation completed

fourClockModel.liveMode: live activation additionally requires local acquisition, validation, verification, and activation before effective_from_utc
fourClockModel.historicalMode: historical promotion depends on point-in-time endpoint evidence and archived artifacts; historical fetched_at_utc is not required to be before the historical settlement deadline
fourClockModel.requiredOrdering: freeze_target_utc <= settlement_deadline_utc; settlement_completed_at_utc <= settlement_deadline_utc; sealed_at_utc <= settlement_deadline_utc; sealed_at_utc <= verified_at_utc <= activated_at_utc <= effective_from_utc

national authority provides the only release-specific historical table needed for point-in-time reconstruction
a future rebasing or table migration is explicitly versioned and retested
invalidExceptionTriggers: using a national endpoint only because it publishes a few hours earlier than the contracted endpoint
using a proxy frequency that cannot be reconstructed across the seven-year test
using credential availability as a reason to switch endpoints
letting market volatility alter the source endpoint for a live week

executableKey: execution_time < effective_to_utc when effective_to_utc is present
snapshotActivation.correctionPolicy: before effective_from_utc a candidate may be superseded; after effective_from_utc changed values cannot replace the trading truth for that macro week, and material defects revoke or quarantine the snapshot so execution fails closed until the next eligible weekly snapshot
snapshotActivation.executionRequirement: execution must read an ACTIVE aggregate weekly snapshot manifest; SEALED row-level source snapshots are evidence only
snapshotActivation.stateTransitionLedger: research_macro_snapshot_state_transitions records from_state, to_state, transitioned_at_utc, transition_run_id, reason, and actor_or_service_version
snapshotActivation.noCarryForwardFallback: execution must not reuse a prior week's sealed or active snapshot when the current macro week fails settlement, verification, activation, or hash checks
snapshotActivation.activeSnapshotUniqueness: exactly one ACTIVE aggregate weekly snapshot manifest may exist for each (promotion_manifest_id, macro_week_id, freeze_version)
snapshotActivation.executionReceiptContract: research_macro_execution_receipts records execution_run_id, decision_at_utc, macro_week_id, promotion_manifest_id, snapshot_id, snapshot_hash, snapshot_state_observed, and snapshot_read_at_utc

weeklySignalFreeze.rule: source rows are eligible only when available_at_utc is at or before the weekly freeze target; intra-week source changes roll to the next weekly snapshot
weeklySignalFreeze.liveSettlementPolicy: weekly snapshot must be built, sealed, reported, and verified before 20:00 America/New_York execution; live execution fails closed otherwise
weeklySignalFreeze.promotedBacktestPolicy: first seven-year macro test uses weekly frozen inputs; midweek source releases are stored as raw observations but cannot change an already-frozen week
weeklySignalFreeze.availabilityRolloverRule: date-only or approximate availability is not promotion-bound and must roll to the first subsequent canonical week open before promotion

eligibilityPolicies.inherit_from_parents: derived row uses the maximum parent availability and parent eligibility constraints
eligibilityPolicies.capture_must_precede_freeze: artifact acquisition must precede the freeze target; post-freeze acquisition is not promotion-safe
eligibilityPolicies.eligible_at_or_before_freeze: source row is eligible when the trusted endpoint availability timestamp/window is at or before the freeze target
eligibilityPolicies.first_freeze_strictly_after_date: date-only availability first becomes eligible at the next canonical weekly freeze after that date

retrievalCapabilities.derived: derived feature inherits retrieval and availability constraints from all parent observations
retrievalCapabilities.as_of_queryable: endpoint can reconstruct historical state as of a requested date or vintage; post-freeze acquisition may be allowed only under that source contract
retrievalCapabilities.release_event_filterable: trusted release events permit exclusion of post-freeze additions
retrievalCapabilities.capture_before_freeze_required: endpoint has no reliable as-of mechanism; live artifact must be captured by the freeze/settlement contract before use

availabilityPrecisions.date: date-only vintage or release precision; equality with the freeze boundary is not sufficient
availabilityPrecisions.inferred: modeled or current-only availability; promotion-blocked unless captured before freeze
availabilityPrecisions.inherited: derived feature inherits parent availability precision
availabilityPrecisions.scheduled_window: scheduled publication window that remains subject to exception-calendar checks

controls.pairWeekJoinTarget: 372 matrix weeks x 28 canonical FX pairs = 10,416 pair-week contexts
controls.executionTruthContract: Join must read an allowed aggregate weekly snapshot manifest. Row-level weekly currency snapshots are sealed source evidence, not execution truth.
outcomeRunnerContract: Outcome runners must require diagnosticOnly=false and promotionEligible=true.
Outcome runners must require blockedPairWeeks=0 and expectedPairWeeks=joinablePairWeeks.
Outcome runners must pin and verify resolvedJoinMapHash instead of reconstructing joins independently.
controls.attributionClock: Future macro attribution starts at manifest effective_from_utc, not week_open_utc.
controls.noOutcomeLogic: This audit does not compute P&L, trade direction, pair filter, stop, TP, runner, or grid-entry behavior.
